Name: Pokemon Eggventure - Interface
Author: Parme69
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Pokémon Eggventure - Interface[/b][/size]
[size=3][i]Your whole valley, framed like a Pokémon game.[/i][/size][/center]

[size=4][b]What is it?[/b][/size]
This mod restyles the entire Stardew Valley interface in a Pokémon style: menus, dialogue boxes, HUD, shops, calendar, title screen and more. Choose between a [b]Modern[/b] look inspired by the recent Pokémon games, or a [b]Wooden[/b] look that keeps Stardew's charm and adds Poké Balls everywhere.

It is part of the [b]Pokémon Eggventure[/b] family, but it works on its own: you don't need any other Eggventure mod to use it.

[size=4][b]Two interface styles[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Modern[/b]: flat menus, square corners and thin outlines, with a Poké Ball on each corner of the windows.
[list]
[*]25 colour presets (Sapphire, Ruby, Emerald, Diamond, Gold, Silver, Night Blue, Burgundy, Pokédex Red, Deep Black and more), or any custom colour with a hex code.[/*]
[*]A secondary colour for selections, hover effects and checked boxes.[/*]
[*]Optional "Filled boxes": windows take the border colour instead of white.[/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][b]Wooden[/b]: Stardew's original wood, with Poké Balls on the corners of windows, dialogue boxes, tooltips and buttons, push pins replaced by Poké Balls, and a Poké Ball on the inventory tab.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]What gets redesigned[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Menu frames, tabs, inventory slots, buttons, scroll bars and tooltips[/*]
[*]Dialogue boxes and the character portrait panel[/*]
[*]Clock, money box, energy and health bars, buff icons, quest button[/*]
[*]Shops: item rows, hover colour and price signs[/*]
[*]Billboard: calendar and daily quests[/*]
[*]Level-up title, fishing bar, item pickup messages, skill page, social page[/*]
[*]Character creation: arrows, gender symbols, options button[/*]
[*]Mouse cursor[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Pokémon title screen[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Three title screen styles: [b]Modern[/b], [b]Wooden[/b] (original wooden buttons with Pokémon icons: an egg, Poké Balls and a door), or [b]Original Stardew[/b].[/*]
[*]Pokémon Eggventure logo, or keep the original Stardew Valley sign if you prefer.[/*]
[*]About 140 Pokémon fly across the sky instead of the birds: legendaries, ghosts drifting half-transparent, shiny Pokémon and every Vivillon pattern. You choose how many, their size, the shiny chance, or a single favourite Pokémon.[/*]
[*]A Pikachu start-up screen, with a new pose on each click.[/*]
[*]Hidden surprises in the classic title screen easter eggs: click around and see who shows up![/*]
[*]Redrawn mountains, clouds and Harvey's balloon, and Pokémon in the introduction.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Pokédollars and Game Boy fonts[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Money becomes the [b]Pokédollar (₽)[/b] in every text, in English and French: "500g" becomes "500₽", "gold coins" becomes "Pokédollars". Gold coin icons are replaced by a golden ₽.[/*]
[*]Letters, titles and bubbles in the [b]Pokémon GB[/b] font. You can also use it for menus and dialogues, or turn either one off.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Handy extras[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][b]Search bar[/b] on the Social and Animals pages: type a name, a nickname or a species. On the Social page the list is filtered; on the Animals page it scrolls to the first match.[/*]
[*]Every option has its own switch: keep only the title screen, only the fonts, only the Pokédollars… as you like.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] 4.0 or later[/*]
[*]Optional but recommended: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to change the settings in game[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Installation[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Unzip the mod into your [i]Mods[/i] folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[/list]To change the settings, use the gear button on the title screen (Generic Mod Config Menu) or edit [i]config.json[/i]. Changes to fonts and Pokédollars need a game restart.

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with the other Pokémon Eggventure mods. Since the latest update, all interface changes from [i]Day Care[/i] are handled here, so they no longer overlap.[/*]
[*]Not compatible with other mods that recolour the whole interface (for example Earthy Interface or other UI recolours): use only one.[/*]
[*]Languages: everything works in all languages. Button labels on the title screen are redrawn in English and French; the Pokédollar text replacement covers English and French.[/*]
[/list]
[size=4][b]Credits[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]"Pokemon GB" and "Pokemon Unown GB" fonts by [b]Jackster Productions[/b] (freeware). Only images rendered from the fonts are included.[/*]
[*]Logo drawn with the "Pocket Monk" font by [b]Chequered Ink[/b] (non-commercial licence). Only the rendered logo is included.[/*]
[*]Inspired by [b]DaisyNiko[/b]'s Earthy Interface.[/*]
[*]Pokémon is © Nintendo, Game Freak and The Pokémon Company. This is a free fan project, not affiliated with them.[/*]
[/list]

Manifest.Description: The whole interface in a Pokemon style: modern (flat, square, any colour) or wooden (Stardew wood with Poke Balls). Pokemon title screen, flying Pokemon, Pokedollars, Game Boy fonts and a search bar for villagers and animals.
